title: Kth Smallest Element in a BST
statement:
Given the root of a binary search tree (BST) and an integer k, return the value of the kth smallest element in the BST.

A binary search tree is a tree where each node has at most two children, and for any node: all values in its left subtree are strictly less than the node's value, and all values in its right subtree are strictly greater than the node's value.
constraints: 1 <= k <= number of nodes in the tree
The tree contains at least k nodes

visibleExamples.explanation: The in-order traversal of the tree is [1, 2, 3, 4]. The 1st smallest element is 1.
The in-order traversal of the tree is [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]. The 3rd smallest element is 3.

jsonFriendlyReason: Requires TreeNode adapter for root parameter
